veg.make_ahead: Meatballs and sauce up to 2 days ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Fry the chopped mushrooms in the olive oil over high heat until dry and browned, then cool.
Mash the lentils roughly, then mix with the mushrooms, ricotta, egg, parmesan, breadcrumbs, garlic, salt and pepper and roll into 16 meatballs.
Bake the meatballs on a lined tray at 200C for 20 minutes until firm.
Simmer the passata with the oregano, add the meatballs and simmer gently for 10 minutes.
Split the long rolls, pack in the meatballs and sauce, lay the provolone on top and grill for 2 to 3 minutes until melted.

veg.make_ahead: Cook the rice a day ahead and chill

steps.text: Cook the jasmine rice the day before, spread it on a tray and chill overnight.
Dice the smoked tofu, slice the spring onions and beat the eggs.

Heat a wok until smoking with half the oil and fry the tofu for 2 minutes. Push it aside, scramble the eggs, then add the rice and 2 tbsp soy sauce and toss for 4 minutes until hot. Stir through the spring onions.
Fry the frozen vegetable dumplings in the rest of the oil in a frying pan for 2 minutes until the bases brown, add the water, cover and steam for 6 minutes.
Serve out of takeaway boxes with the rest of the soy sauce on the side.

veg.make_ahead: Cook the beer onions up to 2 days ahead and keep chilled; grill the sausages and fill the rolls on the night

steps.text: Slice the onions and cook in the butter in a wide pan until soft.
Pour in the lager and simmer until most of it evaporates and the onions are sticky.
Grill the vegetarian sausages on a hot barbecue, turning, for 8 to 10 minutes until charred, then turn them through the beer onions for 2 minutes.
Toast the long rolls, warm the sauerkraut and fill each roll with a sausage, onions, sauerkraut and hot mustard.

veg_af.make_ahead: Cook the stock and cider vinegar onions up to 2 days ahead and keep chilled; grill the sausages and fill the rolls on the night

steps.text: Slice the onions and cook in the butter in a wide pan until soft.
Pour in the vegetable stock and cider vinegar and simmer until most of it evaporates and the onions are sticky.
Grill the vegetarian sausages on a hot barbecue, turning, for 8 to 10 minutes until charred, then turn them through the onions for 2 minutes.
Toast the long rolls, warm the sauerkraut and fill each roll with a sausage, onions, sauerkraut and hot mustard.

veg.n: Mae's stretch-it mushroom and lentil stew
veg.make_ahead: Better the next day, keep chilled

steps.text: Brown the mushrooms in the olive oil in batches in a heavy pot.
Chop the onions, carrots and potatoes, then soften the onions in the pot.
Add the carrots, potatoes, barley, lentils, stock and thyme and return the mushrooms.
Simmer, stirring now and then, until the barley is tender and the stew is thick.
Serve with the bread.

veg.make_ahead: Crumb the eggplant up to 4 hours ahead in the fridge; boil and dress the potatoes warm and fry the schnitzels just before serving

steps.text: Slice the eggplants lengthways 1 cm thick, salt them and leave for 10 minutes, then pat dry.
Crumb the eggplant slices in the flour, beaten eggs and panko.
Boil the potatoes until tender, then slice and toss warm with the vinegar, oil and salt.
Fry the schnitzels in the butter in batches until golden outside and soft inside.
Serve with the lemons cut into wedges.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, reheats well

steps.text: Grate the beetroot and carrots, shred the cabbage and dice the potatoes.
Simmer the beetroot, carrots, cabbage and potatoes in the vegetable stock until tender.
Season with the dill and vinegar.
Serve in bowls with the sour cream.

veg.make_ahead: Best eaten straight away

steps.text: Cut the potatoes into thin frites, rinse and dry thoroughly.
Cut two thick steaks from the middle of each cauliflower, brush with the olive oil and season. Sear in a heavy ovenproof pan on both sides, then roast at 200C for 20 minutes until tender.
Fry the frites in the neutral oil at 140C, then drain and cool.
Fry again at 185C until crisp. Season with salt.
Add the cracked black peppercorns to the cauliflower pan, then carefully add the brandy away from the flame. Add the stock and reduce.
Add the cream and simmer until thick. Serve the cauliflower steaks with the sauce and frites.

veg_af.n: Frank's Plaza cauliflower steak dinner (alcohol free)

steps.text: Cut the potatoes into thin frites, rinse and dry thoroughly.
Cut two thick steaks from the middle of each cauliflower, brush with the olive oil and season. Sear in a heavy ovenproof pan on both sides, then roast at 200C for 20 minutes until tender.
Fry the frites in the neutral oil at 140C, then drain and cool.
Fry again at 185C until crisp. Season with salt.
Add the cracked black peppercorns to the cauliflower pan, then add the cider vinegar. Add the stock and reduce.
Add the cream and simmer until thick. Serve the cauliflower steaks with the sauce and frites.

veg.make_ahead: Gratin up to 1 day, reheat gently

steps.text: Layer the potatoes in a dish with most of the cream and bake at 180C.
Wilt the spinach, squeeze dry and mix with the ricotta and parmesan. Pull the stalks from the portobello mushrooms and fill the cups.
Brush the stuffed mushrooms with the oil and roast at 200C alongside for the last 15 minutes.
Cook the sliced mushrooms in the butter, add the remaining cream and simmer until thick. Serve over the stuffed mushrooms.

veg.make_ahead: Soak up to 1 day ahead, fry fresh

steps.text: Cut the cauliflower into large florets and combine with the buttermilk, hot sauce and half the salt. Soak in the fridge for at least 1 hour.
Peel, chop and boil the potatoes until tender, then mash with 60 g of the butter and 200 ml of the milk.
Mix 200 g of the flour with the paprika, garlic powder and the rest of the salt and toss the cauliflower through it.
Fry in the vegetable oil at 175C in batches for 5 to 6 minutes until golden and tender.
Melt the last of the butter, stir in the remaining flour, whisk in the rest of the milk and the pepper and simmer into a gravy.
Warm the honey with the chilli flakes and drizzle over the cauliflower.

veg.make_ahead: Assemble up to 1 day ahead, covered in the fridge; add 5 to 10 minutes to the bake

steps.text: Soak the dried chillies in hot water for 15 minutes.
Toss the sweet potato in the olive oil and roast at 200C until tender.
Blitz the chillies with the crushed tomatoes and garlic and simmer 10 minutes into a sauce.
Mix the sweet potato with the black beans and half the cheddar, roll in the corn tortillas and pack into a baking dish.
Cover with the sauce and the rest of the cheddar and bake at 190C for 20 minutes.
Serve with the sour cream.

veg.make_ahead: Mix the tomato sauce up to 2 days ahead, and slice the sausages and mushrooms up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; stretch, top and bake on the night

steps.text: Heat a pizza steel in the oven at its maximum.
Mix the tomatoes with the crushed garlic and oregano. Thinly slice the vegetarian sausages and mushrooms and grate the mozzarella.
Stretch the dough into two thin bases and top with the sauce, sausage, mushrooms and cheese.
Bake on the hot steel at maximum heat.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 4 hours ahead, wrapped and chilled

steps.text: Slice the smoked tofu as thin as you can. Split the rolls and spread with mayonnaise.
Layer with the tofu, Swiss cheese, lettuce and tomato. Season with salt and pepper.
Close, wrap tightly in paper and cut in half.

veg.n: Valiant & Valiant mushroom pastrami on rye
veg.make_ahead: Slice and toss the mushrooms with the spices and soy up to 4 hours ahead in the fridge; fry, pile and grill on the night

steps.text: Slice the mushrooms thickly and toss with the smoked paprika, coriander, pepper and soy sauce.
Fry in the oil in a hot pan until browned and glossy.
Pile onto the rye spread with mustard and top with the Swiss cheese.
Grill until the cheese melts. Serve each with a dill pickle.

veg.make_ahead: Rub the cauliflowers up to 1 day ahead and keep covered in the fridge; roast on the night

steps.text: Crush the garlic and mix with the chopped rosemary, paprika, oil and salt. Trim the cauliflowers and rub them all over.
Roast covered at 200C for 30 minutes, then uncovered for 40 minutes until charred and tender.
Tear the cauliflower into big chunks.
Pick the mint and parsley leaves and toss with the lemon juice into a salad.
Serve with warm flatbreads and the salad.

veg.make_ahead: Marinate the eggplant up to 4 hours ahead

steps.text: Crush 4 of the garlic cloves and mix with the chopped rosemary, lemon juice and zest and the oil. Cut the eggplants into thick rounds, toss with half the mix and leave for 30 minutes.
Roast the capsicums at 220C until blistered, then peel and slice.
Grill the eggplant hot until charred outside and soft inside.
Slice the haloumi thick, grill for 1 to 2 minutes a side and spoon over the rest of the garlic mix.
Crush the last garlic clove into the yoghurt with a pinch of salt. Serve with the haloumi, eggplant and capsicums.

veg.n: Shredded mushroom, rice, beans and plantains
veg.make_ahead: Mushroom braise up to 1 day ahead

steps.text: Shred the king oyster mushrooms lengthways with a fork.
Fry the mushrooms in 2 tbsp of the oil until golden, add the onions and cumin, then the tomatoes and simmer for 25 minutes until thick.
Cook the rice and warm the black beans.
Fry the plantain slices in 2 tbsp of the oil until golden.
Fry the eggs in the last of the oil.
Serve it all on one plate.

veg.make_ahead: Dice the onions up to 1 day ahead in the fridge and press and cut the plant-based patties up to 4 hours ahead; steam and assemble on the night

steps.text: Press the plant-based mince thin between sheets of baking paper and cut into 16 squares.
Finely dice the onions and spread them in a hot pan with the oil and a splash of water. Lay the patties on top, cover and steam for 3 to 4 minutes, in batches.
Add the cheddar and serve in the small soft buns with pickles.

veg.make_ahead: Make the ragu up to 3 days ahead and reheat gently; cook the polenta fresh and beat in the butter at the end

steps.text: Slice the vegetarian sausages and the mushrooms.
Brown the sausage in the oil and lift out, then fry the mushrooms until golden.
Add the tomatoes, return the sausage and simmer for 25 minutes.
Cook the polenta in the boiling water, stirring, until thick.
Beat in the butter and parmesan and spoon the ragu over the polenta.

veg.n: Fred Gailey's New York celeriac pot roast
veg.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, reheat to serve

steps.text: Peel the celeriac, cut into 8 thick wedges and sear all over in the oil.
Add the onion, carrots, celery, wine, soy sauce and enough stock to come halfway.
Cover and braise at 180C for 40 minutes.
Add the potatoes and braise for another hour until everything is tender.
Spoon the juices over and serve.

veg_af.n: Fred Gailey's New York celeriac pot roast (alcohol free)
veg_af.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, reheat to serve

steps.text: Peel the celeriac, cut into 8 thick wedges and sear all over in the oil.
Add the onion, carrots, celery, balsamic vinegar, soy sauce, extra stock and enough stock to come halfway.
Cover and braise at 180C for 40 minutes.
Add the potatoes and braise for another hour until everything is tender.
Spoon the juices over and serve.

veg.n: Business dinner portobello steak and red wine jus
veg.make_ahead: Bake the gratin up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled and reheat; sear the portobellos and finish the red wine jus on the night

steps.text: Slice the potatoes thin, chop the shallots and trim the beans.
Layer the potatoes with the cream, crushed garlic and salt, and bake at 160C.
Brush the portobello mushrooms with the oil, season, sear on both sides, then roast at 200C for 15 minutes.
Soften the shallots in a little of the butter in the pan. Add the wine and reduce by half, then add the stock and soy sauce and reduce until glossy. Whisk in some more butter.
Steam the beans and toss with the remaining butter.

veg_af.n: Business dinner portobello steak and balsamic jus
veg_af.make_ahead: Bake the gratin up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled and reheat; sear the portobellos and finish the balsamic jus on the night

steps.text: Slice the potatoes thin, chop the shallots and trim the beans.
Layer the potatoes with the cream, crushed garlic and salt, and bake at 160C.
Brush the portobello mushrooms with the oil, season, sear on both sides, then roast at 200C for 15 minutes.

Soften the shallots in a little of the butter in the pan. Add the extra stock and balsamic vinegar and reduce by half, then add the stock and soy sauce and reduce until glossy. Whisk in some more butter.
Steam the beans and toss with the remaining butter.

veg.make_ahead: Soak up to 4 hours ahead

steps.text: Pull the oyster mushrooms into large clusters and soak in the buttermilk and hot sauce in the fridge for 1 hour.
Season the flour with the paprika and salt and dredge the mushrooms twice, dipping back into the buttermilk in between.
Fry in the oil in a cast iron pan at 175C in batches for 3 to 4 minutes until deep golden and crisp.
Drain on a rack.

veg.n: Wedding banquet crispy sweet and sour tofu
veg.make_ahead: Eat straight away for the best crunch

steps.text: Pat the tofu dry, cut into bite size pieces and toss in the egg white, then the potato starch.
Cook the rice.
Fry the tofu in the oil at 180C, rest it, then fry again until very crisp.
Julienne the carrot, slice the capsicum and garlic and stir-fry with the pineapple in 1 tbsp of the oil.
Mix the rice vinegar, sugar, tomato sauce, soy and cornflour with the water, add to the wok and bubble until glossy.
Toss in the tofu and serve with the rice.

veg.make_ahead: Cook the onions up to 2 days ahead in the fridge; grill the vegetarian franks and toast the buns to order

steps.text: Slice the onions and cook slowly in the butter.
Score the vegetarian franks and grill over coals, turning, until blistered.
Toast the buns and fill with the franks, onions, mustard and sweet relish.

veg.make_ahead: Filling up to 1 day ahead

steps.text: Heat the oven to 190C. Halve the zucchini and scoop out the middles, chopping the flesh.
Fry the onion and mushrooms in the oil until browned, then add the zucchini flesh, lentils, tomatoes and thyme and cook until thick.
Fill the zucchini shells and cover with the cheddar.
Bake until tender and bubbling.

veg.n: Tofu, coconut black rice and pickles
veg.make_ahead: Pickle the carrots and cabbage up to 3 days ahead; press and slice the tofu up to 1 day ahead

steps.text: Shred the carrots and cabbage and pickle them in the vinegar, sugar and a pinch of salt for 30 minutes.
Simmer the black rice in the coconut milk plus a splash of water until tender.
Slice the tofu into thick slabs, brush with the soy sauce and oil and grill until charred on both sides.
Serve the tofu on the purple rice with the pickles.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, reheats well

steps.text: Brown the mushrooms in batches in the oil in a heavy pot.
Add the onions and paprika and stir until soft and fragrant.
Add the tomatoes and stock and return the mushrooms.
Simmer gently, stirring now and then, until the sauce is thick.
Cook the noodles and toss with the butter.
Serve the goulash over the noodles with the sour cream.

veg.make_ahead: Better the next day, keep chilled

steps.text: Chop the onions and soften in the oil with the ras el hanout and saffron.
Add the pumpkin, stock, apricots and chickpeas.
Cook covered until the pumpkin is tender.
Pour the boiling water over the couscous, cover for 5 minutes, fluff and serve under the tagine with the chopped parsley.

veg.make_ahead: Boil, cool and dress the potato salad up to 1 day ahead, covered in the fridge; fry the mushrooms and build the sandwiches on the night

steps.text: Boil the potatoes until tender, cool and toss with the mayonnaise, celery and dill.
Slice the mushrooms thickly, toss with the paprika, coriander, pepper and soy sauce and fry in the oil until browned and glossy.
Pile high on the rye spread with the mustard.
Serve each sandwich with a whole dill pickle and the potato salad.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 2 days ahead

steps.text: Brown the eggplant in the oil in batches, then soften the chopped onions.
Add the ras el hanout, stock, chickpeas, dates and sliced preserved lemon and return the eggplant.
Cover and simmer gently until the eggplant is soft.
Pour the boiling water over the couscous, cover for 5 minutes and fluff. Toast the almonds.
Serve the tagine over the couscous with the almonds.

veg.n: Meatball cannon dinner with mushroom meatballs
veg.make_ahead: Fry the mushrooms and mix the lentil balls up to 1 day ahead and keep chilled; simmer in the tomatoes up to 2 days ahead and reheat gently. Cook the spaghetti on the night

steps.text: Fry the mushrooms in 1 tbsp of the oil until dry and browned, then cool.
Mash the lentils roughly and mix with the mushrooms, ricotta, parmesan, egg, breadcrumbs, salt and pepper. Roll into balls.
Brown the meatballs gently in the rest of the oil.
Add the tomatoes and torn basil and simmer for 20 minutes.
Cook the spaghetti and pile the meatballs on top.

veg.make_ahead: Marinate up to 1 day ahead

steps.text: Blitz the chillies, allspice, thyme, spring onions, garlic, lime juice and oil into a paste.
Cut the cauliflowers into thick wedges, coat in the paste and marinate in the fridge for 2 hours.
Cook the rice with the kidney beans, coconut milk and water.
Grill the cauliflower over medium coals, turning, until charred and tender.
Serve the cauliflower on the rice.

veg.n: Wedding buffet mushroom and white bean braise
veg.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, keep chilled

steps.text: Brown the mushrooms in the oil in batches.
Add the thyme and wine and bubble for 2 minutes, then add the beans and 200 ml of the stock and braise for 15 minutes.
Cook the rice with the butter and the rest of the stock for a pilaf.
Stir the cream into the mushrooms and serve with the pilaf.

veg_af.n: Wedding buffet mushroom and white bean braise (alcohol free)

steps.text: Brown the mushrooms in the oil in batches.
Add the thyme, lemon juice, beans and 400 ml of the stock and braise for 15 minutes.
Cook the rice with the butter and the remaining 400 ml of stock for a pilaf.
Stir the cream into the mushrooms and serve with the pilaf.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, reheats well

steps.text: Fry the mushrooms and onion in the oil until dry, then cool slightly.
Mash the lentils and mix with the mushrooms, breadcrumbs, eggs, cheddar, soy sauce and salt. Press into a lined loaf tin.
Spread with the tomato sauce mixed with the brown sugar and bake at 180C for 45 minutes, then rest 10 minutes.
Boil and mash the potatoes with most of the butter. Cook the flour in the last of the butter and whisk in the stock for a gravy.
Serve thick slices with the mash and gravy.

veg.n: Whole roast cauliflower with potato gratin
veg.make_ahead: Assemble the gratin up to 1 day ahead, covered in the fridge, and add 10 minutes to the bake; rub and roast the cauliflower on the day

steps.text: Slice the potatoes thinly and layer with the cream, crushed garlic and salt in a dish.
Bake the potatoes at 180C.
Rub the whole cauliflower with the oil, salt and pepper and roast alongside the potatoes for the last 50 minutes.
Melt the butter in a pan, stir in the flour, then whisk in the stock and soy sauce and reduce until glossy.
Cook the green beans.
Carve the cauliflower into thick wedges and serve with the gratin, gravy and beans by candlelight.

veg.n: Ryback's bouillabaisse with potatoes and poached eggs
veg.make_ahead: Soften the vegetables up to 2 days ahead and chill; add the stock and potatoes, then poach the eggs on the night

steps.text: Chop the fennel, leek, onion and garlic.
Soften them in the oil with the saffron, orange peel and tomatoes.
Add the stock and potatoes and simmer until the potatoes are tender.
Crack the eggs into the simmering broth, cover and poach for 4 minutes.
Toast the sliced baguette and serve with the rouille.

veg.make_ahead: Crumb up to 3 hours ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Slice the eggplants lengthways 1 cm thick, salt and leave 10 minutes, then pat dry. Dust in the flour, dip in the egg and coat in the breadcrumbs.
Shallow-fry in the oil for 2 to 3 minutes a side until golden.
Warm about half the passata, top each cutlet with sauce, mozzarella and parmesan and grill until bubbling.
Cook the spaghetti and toss in the rest of the passata, heated.

veg.make_ahead: Sauce up to 1 day, fry chips fresh

steps.text: Cut the potatoes into thin fries.
Cut two thick steaks from the middle of each cauliflower, brush with the olive oil and season. Sear on both sides in an ovenproof pan, then roast at 200C for 20 minutes.
Fry the fries twice in the vegetable oil until crisp and salt them.
Toast the cracked peppercorns in the pan, add the cream and simmer until thick.
Serve the cauliflower steaks with the sauce, fries and salad leaves.

veg.make_ahead: Best served hot

steps.text: Simmer the sauerkraut with the wine, apple and caraway.
Brush the vegetarian sausages with the oil and grill, turning, until browned.
Boil the potatoes until tender and toss in the butter.
Serve together.

veg_af.n: German sausages and kraut (vegetarian, alcohol free)

steps.text: Simmer the sauerkraut with the apple juice, cider vinegar, apple and caraway.
Brush the vegetarian sausages with the oil and grill, turning, until browned.
Boil the potatoes until tender and toss in the butter.
Serve together.

veg.make_ahead: Fry the tofu and mix the dressing up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; layer and grill the sandwiches on the night

steps.text: Slice the smoked tofu thin and fry in the oil until crisp at the edges.
Mix the mayonnaise with the tomato sauce and chopped pickle for the dressing.
Layer the rye with the tofu, sauerkraut, Swiss cheese and dressing, then butter the outsides.
Grill in a pan until golden and melting.
Cut in half to serve.

veg.make_ahead: Marinate the mushrooms up to 4 hours ahead in the fridge and mix the tzatziki up to 1 day ahead; griddle on the night

steps.text: Slice the mushrooms lengthways, toss with the garlic, oregano, lemon juice and oil and marinate for 20 minutes.
Griddle the mushrooms, turning once, until charred and tender, then slice thin.
Mix the yoghurt with the cucumber and extra garlic for tzatziki.
Warm the pitas and wrap the mushrooms with tzatziki, tomato and red onion.

veg.n: Cleveland Polish boy with fries and slaw (vegetarian)
veg.make_ahead: Shred the cabbage and grate the carrot up to 1 day ahead and dress the slaw up to 3 hours ahead, keep chilled. Bake the chips and grill the sausages on the night

steps.text: Bake the chips at 220C until crisp.
Toss the cabbage and carrot with the mayonnaise, vinegar and sugar for the slaw.
Score the vegetarian sausages, brush with the oil and grill, turning, until charred.
Split the rolls, lay a sausage in each, pile on hot chips, drizzle with barbecue sauce and top with slaw.

veg.make_ahead: Best baked fresh; slice the mushrooms and portion the dough up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Stretch the dough into two thin bases.
Spread with the tomatoes and top with the mozzarella, plant-based pepperoni and mushrooms.
Bake on a hot steel at max heat for 7 minutes. Rewatch the tape.

veg.make_ahead: Cook the mushroom filling up to 2 days ahead in the fridge; cover with pastry and bake on the day, and fry the chips to serve

steps.text: Brown the mushrooms in the olive oil in batches, then soften the onions.
Stir in the flour first, then add the ale, stock and soy sauce and simmer for 25 minutes until thick.
Cool slightly, tip into a pie dish and cover with the puff pastry.
Bake at 200C until puffed and golden.
Cut the potatoes into chips and fry them twice in the vegetable oil.
Cook and crush the peas.

veg_af.n: Pub pie and chips (vegetarian, alcohol free)
veg_af.make_ahead: Cook the mushroom and malt vinegar filling up to 2 days ahead in the fridge; cover with pastry and bake on the day, and fry the chips to serve

steps.text: Brown the mushrooms in the olive oil in batches, then soften the onions.
Stir in the flour first, then add the extra stock, malt vinegar, stock and soy sauce and simmer for 25 minutes until thick.
Cool slightly, tip into a pie dish and cover with the puff pastry.
Bake at 200C until puffed and golden.
Cut the potatoes into chips and fry them twice in the vegetable oil.
Cook and crush the peas.

veg.n: Kumail's mum's paneer and cauliflower biryani
veg.make_ahead: Marinate and assemble a day ahead, bake fresh

steps.text: Mix the paneer and cauliflower with the yoghurt, garam masala and salt, then marinate in the fridge for 30 minutes.
Slice the onions and fry in the oil until crisp.
Par-cook the basmati for a few minutes and drain.
Layer the paneer mix, rice and onions in a heavy pot and drizzle with the saffron soaked in the warm milk.
Seal the pot and bake at 170C.

veg.make_ahead: Rub up to 4 hours ahead, grill fresh

ingredients.item: garlic clove, crushed, for the sauce

steps.text: Halve the eggplants lengthways, score the flesh deeply and rub with the harissa, garlic, cumin and oil.
Leave for 20 minutes.
Grill cut side down over medium heat, then turn and cover until soft, 20 to 25 minutes.
Pour the boiling water over the couscous and chickpeas and cover for 5 minutes. Mix the sauce garlic into the yoghurt and serve the eggplant over the couscous with the sauce.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, reheats well

steps.text: Chop the onions, carrots and potatoes and halve the mushrooms.
Brown the mushrooms in the oil.
Add the onions, carrots, stout and stock and simmer for 20 minutes.
Add the potatoes and lentils and simmer until thick.
Serve in bowls with the crusty bread.
Chop the onions, carrots and potatoes and halve the mushrooms.
Brown the mushrooms in the oil.
Add the onions, carrots, extra stock, malt vinegar and stock and simmer for 20 minutes.
Add the potatoes and lentils and simmer until thick.
Serve in bowls with the crusty bread.

veg.n: Foil baked haloumi with lemon and dill
veg.make_ahead: Fill and wrap the foil parcels up to 1 day ahead and keep chilled; bake and boil the potatoes on the night

steps.text: Slice the zucchini and haloumi and lay them on four sheets of foil with the lemon slices, dill and garlic.
Dot with some of the butter and wrap each into a parcel.
Bake at 200C and open at the table.
Boil the potatoes until tender.
Toss with the remaining butter.

veg.n: Waterfall feast jollof rice with grilled haloumi
veg.make_ahead: Best served hot

steps.text: Blitz the tomatoes, capsicum, onion and chilli.
Fry the blended sauce in the oil until deep red.
Stir in the rice, stock and thyme, cover and bake at 170C.
Slice the haloumi and grill in a hot dry pan until charred on both sides.
Lay the haloumi on the rice and serve.

veg.n: D Company field kitchen mushrooms and beans
veg.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, keep chilled and reheat

steps.text: Quarter the mushrooms and dice the onion, capsicum and garlic.
Brown the mushrooms in batches in the oil.
Add the onion, garlic and capsicum and cook.
Stir in the paprika, cumin, crushed tomatoes, stock and drained cannellini beans.
Cover and simmer until thick.
Cook the rice and stir through the butter.
Serve with sliced pickled chilli.

veg.make_ahead: Toss the cauliflower in the oil and spices up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; roast, glaze and boil the corn on the day

steps.text: Cut the cauliflower into big florets and toss with the oil, salt, pepper and smoked paprika.
Roast at 200C until starting to colour.
Brush with the barbecue sauce and roast, basting twice, until sticky.
Boil the corn for 6 minutes and roll in the butter.
Serve the cauliflower with the corn and potato salad.

veg.make_ahead: Mix the lemon oil and slice the haloumi up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; whisk the dressing up to 2 days ahead, then grill and toss on the night

steps.text: Mix the oil, lemon zest and juice, garlic and oregano. Slice the haloumi thick.
Grill the corn and cut off the kernels.
Grill the haloumi for 1 to 2 minutes a side and spoon the lemon mix over.
Whisk the buttermilk, mayonnaise, chives and dill into a dressing.
Toss the lettuce, tomatoes, cucumber and sliced avocado, then top with the haloumi and corn and drizzle with the dressing.

veg.make_ahead: Better made the day before

steps.text: Brown the mushrooms in the oil in batches.
Soften the chopped onion, carrots and celery, then stir in the tomato paste.
Add the wine, stock, lentils and thyme and return the mushrooms.
Cover and simmer gently, then season with salt and pepper.
Boil the potatoes towards the end and mash with the butter. Serve the stew on top.

veg_af.n: Trish's stew, made properly (vegetarian, alcohol free)

steps.text: Brown the mushrooms in the oil in batches.
Soften the chopped onion, carrots and celery, then stir in the tomato paste.
Add the extra stock, balsamic vinegar, stock, lentils and thyme and return the mushrooms.
Cover and simmer gently, then season with salt and pepper.
Boil the potatoes towards the end and mash with the butter. Serve the stew on top.

veg.n: Dining car haloumi with brown butter and almonds
veg.make_ahead: Best fresh

steps.text: Slice the haloumi thick, dust in the flour and season with pepper.
Fry in the frying butter until crisp on both sides.
Brown the sauce butter with the almonds, then add the lemon juice and chopped parsley.
Spoon over the haloumi.

veg.n: Ricky Tan's Hong Kong five spice roast tofu
veg.make_ahead: Press up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Press the tofu between clean tea towels under a weight for 30 minutes, then cut into thick slabs.
Rub with the five spice and salt and toss in the oil.
Roast at 220C for 25 minutes, turning once.
Brush with the honey loosened with the hot water and roast for 10 minutes more.
Cook the rice and serve with the tofu and plum sauce.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 3 days, reheats well

steps.text: Toast the hazelnuts and rub off the skins.
Soften the onion and celery in the butter.
Add the potatoes, most of the hazelnuts and the stock.
Simmer until the potato is soft.
Blend smooth and stir in the cream.
Top with the rest of the hazelnuts, crushed, and the chives.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, bake fresh

steps.text: Soak the bread in some of the milk and chop the onion.
Fry the onion and mushrooms in the oil with the curry powder and turmeric.
Stir in the lentils, chutney and the squeezed bread, then press into a dish.
Beat the eggs with the remaining milk and pour over. Add the bay leaves and bake at 180C.

veg.n: Gede's seaweed farm tempeh nasi goreng
veg.make_ahead: Best fresh

steps.text: Dice the tempeh, crush the garlic, chop the chillies and slice the cucumber.
Stir fry the tempeh in the oil with the garlic and chilli in a very hot wok until golden.
Add the cold rice and kecap manis and toss until smoky.
Fry the eggs and serve on top with the cucumber slices.

veg.make_ahead: Chop the onion and prep the salad up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled; brown the mince and melt the cheese on the night

steps.text: Fry the onion in the oil on a hot griddle until soft.
Add the plant-based mince and chop it up with a spatula as it browns, seasoning well with salt and pepper.
Lay the cheese on top and chop through until melted.
Toast the rolls. Pile in the filling with the lettuce, tomato and mayonnaise.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, reheats well

steps.text: Put the carrots, celery and onion in a pot with the stock and water.
Simmer until the vegetables are tender, then lift out the onion.
Add the beans and noodles and cook for 5 minutes.
Finish with the parsley and a squeeze of lemon.

veg.make_ahead: Wrap the potatoes in foil up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; rub the mushrooms with the oil and rosemary up to 2 hours ahead and grill on the night

steps.text: Wrap each potato with a knob of butter in foil.
Bake in the coals.
Rub the mushrooms with the oil, salt, pepper and chopped rosemary.
Grill over hot coals for about 4 minutes a side.
Split the potatoes and serve with the mushrooms.

veg.make_ahead: Slice the capsicums and onions up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; cook the sausages and vegetables on the night

steps.text: Grill the vegetarian sausages slowly in half the oil until browned all over.
Slice the capsicums and onions.
In the same pan, soften the capsicums and onions in the rest of the oil with the oregano.
Pile the sausages and peppers into the rolls and add hot mustard.

veg.make_ahead: Spread the herb butter over the pumpkin up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled; roast on the night

steps.text: Mash some of the butter with the chopped sage, thyme and one garlic clove. Halve and seed the pumpkin, score the flesh and spread the butter over.
Roast at 200C until soft and browned.
Boil the potatoes and mash with some of the butter and the milk.
Melt a little butter, whisk in the flour, add the stock and soy sauce and simmer to a gravy.
Blanch the beans and toss with the last of the butter and the other garlic clove. Serve with the cranberry sauce.

veg.make_ahead: Simmer the tofu curry up to 1 day ahead without the beans and basil and keep chilled; reheat gently, add the beans and basil and cook the rice fresh

steps.text: Cook the jasmine rice.
Fry the green curry paste in the thick top of the coconut milk until fragrant.
Add the tofu and turn gently for 3 minutes.
Pour in the rest of the coconut milk, the stock, the torn makrut lime leaves, the soy sauce and the palm sugar.
Simmer 12 minutes, adding the snake beans for the last 5.
Stir in the Thai basil and serve with the rice and sliced chilli.

veg.n: Sweet and sour cauliflower with rice
veg.make_ahead: Cut the cauliflower into florets up to 1 day ahead and keep chilled; coat, fry and sauce just before serving

steps.text: Cut the cauliflower into small florets, toss with the soy sauce and a splash of water, then coat in most of the cornflour. Slice the capsicum.
Cook the rice by the absorption method and keep warm.
Fry the cauliflower in batches in the oil at 180C until crisp, then drain.
Stir fry the capsicum and pineapple in a wok, add the vinegar, sugar, tomato sauce and water, and thicken with the last of the cornflour mixed with a little water.
Toss the cauliflower through the sauce and serve with the rice.

veg.make_ahead: Cut the corn into ribs up to 1 day ahead, covered in the fridge; rub, roast and glaze on the night

steps.text: Cut each corn cob in half crossways, then carefully quarter each piece lengthways with a heavy knife.
Rub with the oil, paprika, brown sugar, crushed garlic, cayenne and salt.
Roast at 220C on a lined tray until curled and golden.
Simmer the tomato sauce with the molasses.
Brush on the glaze and glaze under the grill.

veg.n: Coruscant opera house glazed roast eggplant
veg.make_ahead: Make fresh

steps.text: Halve the eggplants lengthways, score the flesh and rub with the salt, five spice and oil. Set cut side up on a tray.
Roast at 200C until soft.
Meanwhile simmer the orange juice, honey, soy and star anise until syrupy.
Brush the glaze over the eggplant and roast another 10 minutes. Steam the rice.
Serve over the rice with the rest of the glaze.

veg.make_ahead: Make the salsa and cook the potato and beans up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; reheat, scramble the eggs and roll on the night

steps.text: Dice the potatoes and fry in the oil until crisp, then add the black beans and smoked paprika.
Make a fresh salsa of diced tomatoes and onion.
Softly scramble the eggs.
Fill the tortillas with the eggs, potato, beans, grated cheddar and salsa.
Roll and toast in a dry pan.

veg.n: Major Hasan's chickpea and haloumi kofte
veg.make_ahead: Mix up to 1 day ahead, cook fresh

steps.text: Mash the chickpeas and mix with the haloumi, grated onion, 2 crushed garlic cloves, cumin, sumac, paprika, half the chopped parsley, breadcrumbs and egg. Chill for 15 minutes.
Shape into 12 long kofte.
Fry in the oil over medium heat, turning, until crisp all over.
Mix the yoghurt with the last crushed garlic clove.
Toss the diced tomatoes and sliced red onion with the rest of the parsley and the lemon juice.
Melt the butter with the chilli flakes.
Serve on warm flatbread with the yoghurt, salad and chilli butter.

veg.make_ahead: Slice the mushrooms and capsicum and trim the beans up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; cook the paella fresh so the base crisps

steps.text: Slice the mushrooms and capsicum and trim the beans.
Brown the mushrooms in the oil in a wide pan, then add the capsicum, beans and smoked paprika.
Add the rice, saffron and chickpeas, then pour in the hot stock.
Simmer without stirring until the bottom crisps.
Serve with the lemons cut into wedges.
